turns.text: Hi, thanks for joining. Why product management?
I've always been the person on my team with a lot of ideas for features, and I want a job where I get to decide what gets built.
Okay. Here's the product question. How would you improve Spotify?

Oh, I love Spotify, I use it every day, so I have a lot of ideas. First, I'd add a feature where you can see what your friends are listening to in real time, like a live feed, right on the home screen.

Second, I'd add lyrics translation, so if you're listening to a song in Spanish you can see it in English. Third, a sleep timer that fades out slowly instead of cutting off. Fourth, better shuffle — everyone complains shuffle isn't really random.
Fifth, I'd add an AI DJ that talks to you between songs and lets you ask for a vibe. And sixth, I think concert tickets should be bookable inside the app.
Which of those would you do?
Honestly, I'd do all of them, they're all pretty quick wins. But if I had to start, I'd probably do the friends feed because it's the coolest, and it would make the app more social.
Anything else you'd want to add?
Maybe dark mode improvements and a widget for the lock screen. I think that would make it a lot better overall.
No, I think I'm good. Thanks!
